about_the_game: Play "Through Glass” by Stone Sour, "My Own Worst Enemy” by Lit, “Ocean Avenue” by Yellowcard, “Feel the Pain” by Dinosaur Jr, and "Hemorrhage (In My Hands)” by Fuel on any electric guitar or bass. Each song includes a new authentic tone.
